title: bombycilaena californica
intro: Bombycilaena californica, commonly known as California silverpuff, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bombycilaena californica include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
